a11y: role="menubar" with a menuitem button for each menu. Only one of them is in the tab order; Left and Right Arrow move between them, Home and End jump.
Enter, Space or Down Arrow opens a menu on its first item; Up Arrow opens it on the last.
Inside a menu, the Dropdown Menu keys work, and Left and Right Arrow open the next menu along.
Once a menu is open, pointing at another button in the bar opens that one instead.
Escape closes the menu and puts focus back on its button.
